articles.title: Bitget hackers move $4 million into Zcash’s private pool, making funds harder to trace
articles.snippet: Three transfers pushed about 15% of the stolen ZEC into Ironwood, where payments hide their senders, recipients and amounts.

articles.title: OpenAI seeks $30 billion in funding at whopping $1.4 trillion valuation after delaying IPO
articles.snippet: The ChatGPT maker is pursuing fresh funding after delaying its public listing, while expanding its AI tools despite mounting safety concerns.

articles.title: XRP Ledger starts carrying fund records from Brazil operator overseeing $4 trillion
articles.snippet: The regulated operator is mirroring ownership of selected investment funds on XRPL while keeping its existing database as the official record.

articles.title: Crypto advocacy group announces picks for US Congress as midterms loom
articles.snippet: The organization’s endorsements in the House and Senate came as many polls showed Democrats favored to regain control of both chambers in 2027.

articles.title: Singapore crypto activity grows 55% as broader region contracts
articles.snippet: Singapore’s crypto economy grew 55.4% to $284 billion as institutional-platform activity surged 94%, while the Philippines, Thailand and Vietnam stood out for small-value P2P transfers.
